protocol.test_policy: Same frozen historical holdout for final comparisons only; never tune on it. Previously evaluated historical data is not a fresh production holdout.
protocol.training: Damage-only task views, repeat-factor sampling threshold 0.2, no unannotated part-only images as negatives, publisher COCO-pretrained weights
protocol.selection: Best validation damage bbox mAP50:95; report precision/recall/FP at common threshold 0.25 and separately at validation-selected operating point. Evaluate selected checkpoint per candidate on the same test images after training.
protocol.segmentation_checkpoint_selection: The framework tracks native mask AP. For the common bbox comparison evaluate its mask-selected best, final checkpoint and retained 5-epoch checkpoints on validation only, then select the best available bbox checkpoint. Report native mask metrics separately.
protocol.ablation_limit: Resolution and LR both change in the 512 candidate; the segmentation candidate also enables the framework bbox/mask-aware crop augmentation to address small damage. These are practical tuning comparisons, not controlled attributions to one factor.
protocol.threshold_selection: Validation only, thresholds 0.25 through 0.95 to preserve the existing API confidence floor: maximize F2 subject to precision >= 0.70 where feasible. If infeasible report that fact; do not invent a feasible operating point. Both tasks are capped at 100 detections per image as required by the API.
protocol.resource_comparison: Fresh isolated ONNX CPU processes, 2 inference threads, same photo and repeat count; report session load, median/p95 photo pipeline latency and native process peak RSS. These are local measurements, not Railway deployment results.

local_cpu_selection_envelope.scope: Engineering comparison assumption across all three benchmark photos; not an asserted Railway quota and excludes assistant/JVM overhead.

additional_requirements: Fresh independent production-like holdout with verified clean and non-vehicle negatives
Per-class support and expert semantic label review
Actual Railway CPU/RAM limit load test
All dataset/framework/weight provenance and notices retained

decision.basis: Best validation bbox mAP50:95 among measured candidates within declared local CPU envelope

limitations: Historical test is reused for comparison, not a fresh production acceptance holdout.
No verified clean/non-vehicle negative set or human relationship accuracy benchmark.
SYNDCAR is correlated synthetic/staged imagery, two shared classes only.
CPU envelopes are local engineering assumptions; actual Railway quotas, JVM and E5/RAG overhead were not measured.

part_compatibility_review.reason: Preserve the historical part model NMS 0.45; initial ensemble exports used 0.50.
part_compatibility_review.reference: Fresh original unified ONNX runtime, not frozen historical Torch predictions

previous_rf_stage_decision.basis: Validation bbox mAP50:95 within declared local CPU envelope, before final test

additional_rtdetr_protocol.stage: Additional multiscale CNN alternative, declared after the RF-DETR comparison; exploratory historical-benchmark extension, not a new blind holdout
additional_rtdetr_protocol.reason: Compare a commercially licensed pretrained multiscale CNN detector for small damage detail and CPU efficiency
additional_rtdetr_protocol.model: PekingU/rtdetr_r18vd, publisher Apache-2.0 weights; Transformers native Apache-2.0 implementation
additional_rtdetr_protocol.dataset: Same frozen HITL canonical splits and same damage-only 709-row repeat-factor train view; no SYNDCAR training
additional_rtdetr_protocol.augmentation: Training-only horizontal flip and limited ColorJitter; boxes transformed with images
additional_rtdetr_protocol.precision: bf16 mixed precision on actual CUDA GPU
additional_rtdetr_protocol.selection: Validation-only common bbox mAP50:95, API cap 100. Test only after checkpoint selection; do not tune on the historical test
additional_rtdetr_protocol.comparison: Same test labels, common score 0.25 and COCO AP; two-thread isolated ONNX CPU where export succeeds

historical_test_observation.note: No production model qualifies. The validation research selection is retained; the observed test ranking is descriptive, not a silent deployment decision.

native_decoder_retained.decision: No candidate satisfies the predeclared precision-gain/recall-drop criteria; retain native decoding
